Probably one of the best casual farming sims on the market. Pretty much a dramatic quality of life improvement and love letter to Harvest Moon. The co-op is a ton of fun on it's own but I would recommend a mod like "Longer Days" to give the timing balance back that you get during single player.

Wholesome game. It has a power of totally captivating you by the simpliest of tasks and routines. Yes, the game about farming (even though its a video game only) can be a bit exhausting at times, as you feel the urge to be as productive as possible, days seem short, time runs too fast, and there is still so mush left to do! The little farmer has no days off and works hard from 6 o'clock in the morning till 2AM, but he doesn't want no days off! And boy it is extremely satisfying to reap all the fruits of your hard labour. I love this game.

Made by one guy in his bedroom and somehow better than several genres' worth of games made by entire studios. Farming, mining, fishing, foraging, romance, combat, a whole town of NPCs with real schedules and personalities — it's absurd how much got packed into something that started as one person's hobby project.

Fair warning: this game will quietly steal entire weekends from you. You sit down to "just finish today's crops" and next thing you know it's 3am, you've married Sebastian, and you still haven't found floor 100 of the mines. The stamina bar is honestly the only thing standing between you and playing this in one unbroken 40-hour sitting.

Recommended without a single reservation. Just warn your friends, family and employer in advance.

I absolutely adore Stardew Valley. There are so many things to do, routes to take, ways to decorate your farm (and other areas!) friends to make, etc.... And the best part is, you can do it at your own pace and without feeling rushed to complete things in one in-game year. The music, seasons, festivals, and the lore of the game create such a cozy and nostalgic feel. I can see myself playing this game for years to come, and I feel that if you enjoy farming sim/slice of life/retro games, you would really enjoy this. You can really feel the love put into this game... thank you ConcernedApe! I can't wait to play Haunted Chocolatier!
